name: OpenWrt Wifi Monitor
description: Read-only OpenWrt telemetry via companion collector
template: <Stack gap="sm"><Group justify="space-between"><Text fw={700}>OpenWrt Wi-Fi & Clients</Text><RefreshButton requestId="snapshot" size="xs" /></Group>{!data.snapshot ? <Text>Waiting for data...</Text> : <Stack gap="xs"><Text size="xs">{data.snapshot.networks?.filter((w)=>w.up).length ?? 0} active SSIDs · {data.snapshot.clients?.length ?? 0} associated · {data.snapshot.knownDevices ?? 0} known devices</Text>{data.snapshot.networks?.map((w) => <Paper key={w.id} withBorder p="xs"><Group justify="space-between"><Text fw={600}>{w.ssid || w.id}</Text><Badge color={w.up ? "green" : "gray"}>{w.up ? (w.clients + " clients") : "OFF"}</Badge></Group><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">{w.radio} · {w.band || "?"} · Ch {w.channel ?? "?"} · {w.width || "?"} · {w.frequency ?? "?"} MHz</Text>{data.snapshot.clients?.filter((c) => c.ifname === w.ifname).map((c) => <Group key={c.mac} justify="space-between"><Stack gap={0}><Text size="xs">{c.mac}</Text><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">RSSI {c.signal ?? "?"} dBm · TX {c.tx_rate == null ? "?" : Math.round(c.tx_rate/1000)} Mbps · RX {c.rx_rate == null ? "?" : Math.round(c.rx_rate/1000)} Mbps</Text></Stack><Badge color={c.weak ? "orange" : "green"}>{c.weak ? "Weak" : "OK"}</Badge></Group>)}</Paper>)}<Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Association history is available in the collector API. First/last seen are observation times.</Text></Stack>}</Stack>
